statement: Patients shall be able to register.
Patients shall be able to log in using valid credentials.
Patients shall be able to search for doctors by specialization.
Patients shall be able to book appointments with available doctors.
Patient information must be secure.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users.
The system should be user friendly.
The service shall be available 99.9% of the time each month.
The system shall send appointment reminders to patients before scheduled appointments.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of changes to patient records.
Customers shall be able to create an account.
Customers shall be able to add products to a shopping cart.
Customers shall be able to place orders using items in the shopping cart.
The platform shall support payments through an external payment gateway.
Payment information shall be encrypted in transit.
Product search results should appear quickly.
The system shall return product search results within 2 seconds for 95% of requests.
The marketplace shall support multiple independent vendors.
The application shall remain available if one catalogue instance fails.
The system shall comply with applicable data protection regulations.
Passengers shall be able to search flights by origin, destination, and travel date.
Passengers shall be able to reserve an available seat on a selected flight.
The system shall prevent two passengers from reserving the same seat for the same flight.
Flight status updates shall be shown to passengers.
The system shall process booking confirmation within 3 seconds under normal operating load.
The booking service shall be scalable.
The system shall integrate with an external airline schedule provider.
The application shall recover unfinished booking transactions after a temporary service interruption.
Administrators shall be able to update flight schedules.
The system shall store booking records for a defined retention period.
Students shall be able to submit assignment files before the deadline.
Lecturers shall be able to publish grades for submitted assignments.
Only authorized lecturers shall be able to modify student grades.
The system should load course pages fast.
The system shall support 2,000 concurrent student sessions during examinations.
The service shall provide automatic backups of submitted assignment files.
Students shall receive notifications when a deadline is changed.
The application shall work on common desktop and mobile browsers.
The system shall allow students to submit assignments and lecturers to grade them in one operation.
The system shall retain audit records for grade changes.
Drivers shall be able to view assigned deliveries.
Drivers shall be able to update delivery status from a mobile device.
The application shall continue to show the current route when network connectivity is temporarily lost.
Location information should be updated frequently.
The system shall encrypt driver location data during transmission.
Dispatchers shall be able to reassign a delivery to another driver.
The platform shall integrate with a mapping provider for route calculation.
Delivery events shall be synchronized with the central system after connectivity is restored.
The system shall support several delivery vehicles.
The system shall provide a mechanism for reporting delivery issues.
